criteria_verification.notes: FakeVoiceApi class created implementing VoiceApi interface with canned transcripts (cycled by call count) and minimal silent WAV data (44-byte header + ~8KB silent PCM, ~9KB total for 0.1s at 44.1kHz). All three methods (voiceTurn, voiceTurnStream, fetchAudioChunk) fully implemented with deterministic responses suitable for hermetic testing.

FlakyVoiceApi decorator created following FlakySessionApi pattern with 'failing' set and 'errorToThrow' field. Supports TransportError (default) plus all six voice-specific errors: VoiceUnavailable, UnsupportedAudioFormat, EmptyRecording, UnintelligibleQuery, QueryTooLong, RecordingTooLarge. Tests verify all error types injectable and recovery when verbs removed from failing set.

VoiceRecorder class created wrapping record package's AudioRecorder. start() sets up auto-stop Timer with maxDuration (60s default) that fires at 60 seconds and calls stop() automatically. Also enforces maxSizeBytes (10MB default). Unit tests verify both defaults (60s, 10MB).

AudioEncoder enum created with aacLc and opus variants. VoiceRecorder constructor accepts encoder parameter with AudioEncoder.aacLc as default. Encoder choice fully injectable via constructor, allowing Phase-0 gate result to flip default without touching fidelity logic. Tests verify both default (aacLc) and fallback (opus) encoders work and that selection is configurable through constructor parameter.

cancel() method implemented that stops recording, cancels auto-stop timer, and resets _isRecording flag without saving or returning bytes. Safe to call even if not recording (guards with early return). After cancel(), isRecording returns false, allowing fresh start() call. Cancel logic cleanly discards state and is tested to verify it leaves recorder in non-recording state.

flutter analyze run on both implementation and test files. Fixed two lint issues: (1) converted encoder parameter to initializing formal (this.encoder), (2) removed unused _recordingPath field. Final analysis shows 'No issues found!' with zero errors or warnings.
